Message log

Review missed messages in the log.

Switch between messages and collected items to find what just happened.

Controls depend on your keyboard, gamepad and camera settings. The in-game guide shows your current bindings.

Classic edition reference

These original pages describe classic mouse and keyboard controls. Use the guidance above for current settings and gamepad controls.

Text window (part 1)

The Text window (currently highlighted) has two modes: "messages" and "collected items". To switch between them use the buttons in the window's upper-left corner.

In "messages" mode the Text window will contain information designed to give you a better understanding about what is happening in the game. This includes information about received and completed quests and missions, the items you've picked up, warnings about wear-and-tear on your weapons and armor and the characters' dialog lines.
In "collected items" mode the Text window will show the total number of items you've picked up in the Game zone and give you information about them.

Text window (part 2)

You can control the Text window with the scroll bar, or with the following keyboard keys:

To open/close the window in "Messages" mode use the <L> key
To open/close the window in "Collected items" mode use the <K> key.

To open/close the Text window use the (currently highlighted) triangle button at the top of the window.
